question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Grotesque
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Grotesque"** means something that is comically or repulsively ugly or distorted. (विकृत)

 
 
• **Example: **The painting depicted a grotesque figure with exaggerated features.
 
 
 
• **"Ugly" **refers to something that is unpleasant or repulsive, especially in appearance. (बदसूरत)
 
 
• **Example: **The building was so ugly that it was often referred to as an eyesore.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Shameful **(शर्मनाक): Deserving or bringing shame or disgrace.

 
 
• **Example:** His behavior at the event was absolutely shameful.
 
 
 
• **Comely **(सुंदर): Pleasant to look at; attractive.
 
 
• **Example: **She was a comely young woman with an infectious smile.
 
 
 
• **Spontaneous** (स्वत:स्फूर्त): Performed or occurring as a result of a sudden inner impulse or inclination and without premeditation.
 
 
• **Example:** His spontaneous decision to take a road trip was exciting.
